description: This file defines the IGatewayListProvider interface in the Orleans.Messaging namespace, which provides methods and properties for managing and retrieving gateway information in an Orleans cluster.

classes.name: IGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Interface that provides Orleans gateways information, including initialization, retrieving gateway list, and properties for staleness and updatability.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the provider, called before other methods to set up necessary resources.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Returns a list of gateway endpoints (URIs) that clients can use to connect to the Orleans cluster.
